title: 1. FC Köln - Wikipedia
content: FC Köln** (German pronunciation:  ⓘ) or **FC Cologne** in English, is a German professional football club based in Cologne, North Rhine-Westphalia. It was formed in 1948 as a merger of the clubs *Kölner Ballspiel-Club 1901* and *SpVgg Sülz 07*. Köln compete in the first-tier Bundesliga after winning the 2024–25 2. 1. FC Köln was formed in 1948 through the merger of Kölner BC 01 and SpVgg Sülz 07, two successful local sides. It was a founding member of the Bundesliga in 1963 and was crowned its inaugural champions the following year. The club enjoyed golden eras in the 1960s and 1980s, winning three national championships and four DFB-Pokal titles; this includes the inaugural Bundesliga and a domestic double in 1978. Kölner BC was formed on 6 June 1901 by a group of young men who were unhappy as part of the gymnastics club FC Borussia Köln and were more interested in football. In 1963, FC Köln became one of the 16 founder members of the Bundesliga, Germany's new professional football league.

title: German football's fan membership figures continue to climb
content: The Bundesliga and Bundesliga 2 are home to some incredible fan membership figures. The Bundesliga and Bundesliga 2 continue to have some of the best supported clubs in the game, with recent figures showing an increase in club memberships in both leagues and Bayern Munich announcing a new world record total. Bayern confirmed at their 2025 annual general meeting at the start of November that they had reached 432,500 members to make them the largest sports club in the world by membership - an achievement president Herbert Hainer said "we can be proud of". It's a huge increase on the 400,000 number they announced to mark the club's 125th anniversary in February, which took them level with Benfica of Portugal, and the total of 382,000 at the previous year's AGM. Dr Hubertus Hess-Grunewald, president and chairman of the supervisory board at Werder, meanwhile, also announced in 2025 when the club reached 64,000 members - of which over 1,000 have been members for life - that "We are incredibly proud of how our membership numbers have grown.

title: All Information | 1. FC Köln
content: # All Information. ##### **Become a FC Member**. Becoming a FC member is the fastest and easiest way to join the FC-family. If you want to become part of the FC family, fill out the form and become a member today! ##### **Important Information**. FC Köln runs from July 1st until June 30th of every year. Membership fees for applications made throughout the fiscal year will be proportionately calculated. For minors and teenagers under 17 years of age the name and signature of a guardian are mandatory. For those who receive the membership as a gift from another person, the recipient will have to sign their name in order to register themselves as a new member. If the gift membership is to be limited to a certain amount of time (e.g. for one fiscal year), this should be noted in the application. Every cancellation request will be confirmed with a written statement.
